# Mirror of `extras/deployment/requirements-vercel.txt` — DO NOT edit
# independently.
#
# This exact copy exists because Vercel's Python builder (@vercel/python)
# resolves the `requirements.txt` nearest to the entrypoint file declared
# in `extras/deployment/vercel.json` (`extras/api/server.py`) before
# falling back to one at the project root. The project root's
# `requirements.txt` is the full Render/Docker ML stack (torch,
# torchvision, pennylane, SimpleITK, nibabel, ...) and must stay that way
# for those targets — so this colocated file is what actually keeps the
# Vercel function bundle under the 500MB serverless function size limit.
# See `extras/deployment/requirements-vercel.txt` for the full rationale;
# keep the two files identical.

fastapi>=0.110.0
uvicorn[standard]>=0.28.0
pydantic>=2.6.0
python-multipart>=0.0.9
PyJWT>=2.8.0
argon2-cffi>=23.1.0
slowapi>=0.1.9
